description: Groups related buttons with optional attached borders and vertical layout.

examples.code:

attributes.name: attached
attributes.description: Joins adjacent buttons without gaps and removes their inner corner rounding.

attributes.name: orientation
attributes.description: Arrangement of buttons: horizontal in a row, or vertical in a column.

attributes.name: stretch
attributes.description: Expands the group to the available width and gives its buttons equal flexible space.

cssproperties.name: --tp-button-group-gap
cssproperties.description: Space between adjacent buttons in the group.

dependencies.name: tp-base
dependencies.summary: Shared base class for tp-* components.

dependencies.name: tp-button
dependencies.summary: Button component that supports native button and link rendering.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-button-group>` element groups related buttons with optional attached borders and vertical layout.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Reading | This component organizes or presents content. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Component itself | No dedicated keyboard action. |
| Embedded controls, when present | Use their normal keyboard interactions. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Choose a component from the hierarchy under the pointer, or around the focused component, then open its help. <kbd>Alt</kbd> is <kbd>Option</kbd> on macOS; include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
